adjudicator.authority: registered protocol amendment B-prime rules; NOT a human sign-off -- Mahmood has not countersigned these two decisions

decisions.question: Which 3-point MACE row from FDA NDA 209053 EMDAC briefing (2023) is the review's value?

reviewer_A.row: Table 19, ITT Population End of Study, FREEDOM (CLP-107)

reviewer_B.row: 3-Point MACE End of Treatment row (span verbatim in reviewB_extraction.json)

decisions.rule_applied: B-prime 'Timepoint': the prespecified analysis at the end of randomised follow-up (on-study / end-of-study ITT); on-treatment or end-of-treatment analyses are sensitivity analyses
decisions.decision: End-of-study row adopted: HR 1.24 (0.90, 1.70). End-of-treatment row recorded as a sensitivity value, not discarded.
decisions.why: Neither reviewer erred on reading; the disagreement is a timepoint/analysis-set selection that the registered rule decides. B's row is the on-treatment analysis.
decisions.consequence: The typed effect object must carry `censoring: on-study|on-treatment` and `timepoint`; a value without them is UNTYPED. Foundation item for the type system (FN/CGX).

decisions.question: Is the abstract's 'major cardiovascular events ... HR 0.82' the 3-point composite the review pools?

reviewer_B.basis: abstract does not enumerate the components; refused to relabel

decisions.rule_applied: Source ladder: value from level 1; endpoint IDENTITY from the lowest level that enumerates components -- registry design_outcomes (level 3, AACT snapshot, offline)
decisions.decision: Endpoint identity resolved from AACT design_outcomes for NCT03819153 (MACE = CV death, non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke); value stays level 1; identity cited at level 3. B's refusal was CORRECT on the held set B was given.
decisions.why: B was sealed to abstracts + two FDA texts and had no registry record; the harness holds the registry record. The resolution is by an additional held source, not by overruling B.
decisions.consequence: FLOW may be pooled only once the AACT design_outcomes row is recorded as a source with its verbatim title span and the snapshot identity; not yet done on the page.
decisions.aact_span: PENDING -- the verbatim design_outcomes title must be written into the source record before the page uses it
